svg.title: X02 Traceability lineage
svg.text: Verified links: packet → event log → reading → exceedance (contributing reading ids) → finding → evidence (provenance). Signal ↔ work order is a human action; the link is held in metadata, not a foreign key. Proposed (roadmap 4): one
correlation id carried from packet to closed work order, and an outcome field on the work order that feeds HUMS baselines.
X02 · OBSERVATION → FINDING → DECISION → EVIDENCE → ACTION
